<entry id="C00944">
<head-word>גָּלִיל</head-word>
<pos> pr. n.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>District</italic>,] esp. 
<italic>Galilee</italic> in Northern Palestine.</definition>
<notes> Shebi. IX, 2 ג' העליון Upper Galilee, ג' התחתון Lower Galilee. Sot. IX, 15 (49
<sup>b</sup>) הַגָּ'. Keth. 9
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr. [ג' בגוים, Snh. 94
<sup>b</sup>, v. גְּלִילָה.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00945">
<head-word>גָּלִילָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>district, circuit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ezek. XLVII, 8.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלִילִין, גְּלִילֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Josh. XXII, 10; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>Galilee</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. XX, 7; a. e.—Sabb. 47
<sup>a</sup>; 78
<sup>a</sup> בג' שנו it refers only to Galilee.—Tosef. Snh. II, 5; Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56
<sup>c</sup> top, a. e. ג' עילאה Upper Galilee, ג' תיתאה (ארעיתא) Lower G.; Snh. 11
<sup>b</sup> גלילאה (corr. acc.).—Erub. 53
<sup>b</sup> בר ג' a Galilean.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00947">
<head-word>גְּלִילָאָה</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key> ch. = h.</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="C00949">גְּלִילִי</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , 
<italic>Galilean</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 53
<sup>b</sup> ג' שוטה (Ms. M. גלילא) foolish Galilean, v. אִימַּר.—Snh. 113
<sup>a</sup> ההוא ג' a certain Galilean; Sabb. 88
<sup>a</sup>. Ḥull. 27
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלִילָאֵי</plural-form>. Y. B. Bath. VI, 15
<sup>c</sup> top.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00948">
<head-word>גְּלִילָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גלל) 
<italic>casting about, contempt</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 94
<sup>b</sup> (play on גליל הגוים, Is. VIII, 23) אני עוש' אותו ג' בגוים Ms. M. (ed. אעשה לו גליל) I will make him (Sennaherib) contemptible among the nations; Yalk. II Kings 237.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00949">
<head-word>גְּלִילִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גָּלִיל) 
<italic>Galilean.</italic></definition>
<notes> Yad. IV, 8 צדוקי ג' Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. only צדוקי) a Galilean Sadducee (heretic).—ר' יוסי הג' R. José the Galilean. Pes. 28
<sup>a</sup>; a. v. fr., v. יוֹסֵי.—*
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלִילִים, גְּלִילִין</plural-form>. Kel. II, 2 הפכים הג' Galilean flasks; Tosef. ib. B. Kam. II, 2 הפכין והג' (read הפכין הג'); ib. 9. [Cmp., however, גָּלָל.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00950">
<head-word>גְּלִילְתָּא, </head-word>

<xref rid="C00883">גִּלָּה</xref>) 
<italic>folding</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 47
<sup>b</sup> מטה גליל' Ms. M. (ed. גללני', Ar. גיליתא) 
<italic>folding couch, cot</italic></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00951">
<head-word>גְּלִים, </head-word>
<head-word>גְּלִימָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גְלַם </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>wrapper, cloak</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXV, 25 ed. כִּגְלִים (ed. Berl. כָּכְלָן, v. כִּילַן, Var. כִּגְלָם). Targ. II Esth. VIII, 15.—Sabb. 77
<sup>b</sup> it is called 
<italic>g’lima</italic>, שנעשה בו כגוֹלֶם ed. (Ms. M. שנעשית כגו') because one looks in it like a shapeless (armless) body (Ms. M. it is rolled up like a lump). Snh. 102
<sup>b</sup> שיפולי ג' trail of the cloak; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלִימֵי</plural-form>. Ib. 110
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00952">
<head-word>גְּלִימָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>גַּלְמָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גְּלַם 2) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>height, hill</italic>—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלִימָתָא, גַּלְמָתָא</plural-form>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. I, II Num. XXIII, 9; Targ. Y. II Gen. XLIX, 26 גּוֹלַמְתָא (read גּוֹלְמָ'). Targ. Y. II ib. 11 sq. גּוֹלְמָתֵיה his hills. Targ. Ps. LXXII, 3 גַּלְמָ'.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>valley</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXXIX, 21. Targ. Josh. XVIII, 28 Var. (ed. Lag. I, p. VIII
<sup>30</sup> גְּלִימַת).—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלִימָתָא, גַּלְמָתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Job XXXIX, 10. Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 19.—גְּלִימִין. Pesik. B’shall. p. 93
<sup>a</sup> ומחית ליה ג' (Ar. גַּלְמָן) and carried him down the valleys.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00953">
<head-word>גַּלֵּינֵי</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (γαλήνη) 
<italic>calm, stillness of wind and wave</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yeb. XV, 15
<sup>d</sup> top אם (היה) הים ג' וכ' if there was a calm sea, and you looked around and there was none &c.; Y. Erub. IV, 21
<sup>d</sup> bot. גלנו ed. Krot. (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00954">
<head-word>גְּלִיפָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="C00955">next w.</xref>) 
<italic>shaping</italic> (of writing), 
<italic>impress, poetry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XVI, 1 ג' תריצא a well-arranged poetry (h. text מכתם). Ib. CXIX, 130 גְּלִיף דבריך the impress of thy words (h. text פֵּתַח).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00955">
<head-word>גְּלִיפָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גָּלַף) 
<italic>shaping, formation</italic> (of speech, cmp. גזם, גּוּזְמָא).</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 33 גְּלִיפַת שפתים eloquence (ref. to Is. LVII, 19).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00956">
<head-word>גַּלִּיצוּר</head-word>
<pos> pr. n.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Gallitsur</italic>, name of an angel.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 20 (defined מְגַלֶּה טעמי צור revealing the reasons of the Creator); Yalk. R’ubeni, Mishpatim end ג' המכונה רזיאל G. surnamed Raziël.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00957">
<head-word>גָּלְיַת, </head-word>
<head-word>גּוֹלְיַת</head-word>
<pos> pr. n. m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>Goliath</italic>, the Philistine.</definition>
<notes> Sot. VIII, 1 בנצחונו של ג' relying on the strength of G. Ib. 42
<sup>b</sup> ג̇ל̇י̇ת … בג̇יל̇וי̇ פנים וכ' he is named G., because he stood before the Lord with barefacedness (defiance). Lev. R. s. 5; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00959">
<head-word>גָּלַל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to roll, unfold, fold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 32
<sup>a</sup> he opens (the scroll), sees the place (to read from), גּוֹלֵל ומברך rolls it up again and says the benediction. Ib. הגּוֹלֵל ס"ת וכ' he who rolls the scrolls up (preparing the place to read from). B. Mets. II, 8 (29
<sup>b</sup>) גוֹלְלָן he must roll the scrolls over (for the purpose of airing); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. Gen. XXIX, 3) 
<italic>to roll off</italic> (one’s shoulders), 
<italic>disregard</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 21 (play on גללו, Job XX, 7) על שג' מצוה וכ' because he disregarded a light command.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִגְלַל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be rolled, folded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to V, 14 והיו נִגְלָלִין they could be folded up. Snh. 68
<sup>a</sup> my two arms which are like two scrolls of the Law שנגללין rolled up (not unfolded, i.e. with me learning is buried which I was prevented from teaching).—Trnsf., with על, 
<italic>to be rolled on top of, to prevail</italic>. Ber. 7
<sup>a</sup> יִגּוֹלּוּ רחמי על וכ' may my mercy prevail over my attributes (of justice &c.). Ib. יגולו רחמיך; v. גִּלְגֵּל.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּגְלָל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be rolled up, folded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 21
<sup>b</sup>; Men. 95
<sup>a</sup> הוּגְלְלוּ הפרוכות when the curtains (of the Tabernacle) were folded up (for removing).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="C00960">
<head-word>גְּלַל</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to roll, unfold</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. גְּלִיל 
<italic>unfolded, visible</italic>. Targ. Cant. V, 14.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>גַּלֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to roll off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. II Gen. XXVIII, 10 (some ed. לִגְלָלָא Pe.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְגְּלַל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>, v. 
<xref rid="C00869">גַּלְגֵּל</xref>, Ithpalp.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="C00961">
<head-word>גָּלָל</head-word>
<head-word>גְּלַל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>rolling along with, appendage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. 15
<sup>a</sup>; Pes. 13
<sup>b</sup> לחם ג' תודה the bread is an appendage of the thank-offering; Men. 80
<sup>a</sup> לִגְלַל תודה.—בִּגְלַל 
<italic>in consequence of, on account of</italic>, v. next w.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>something rolled, rounded, ball, ordure, excrement, dung</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. III, 3 ההופך את הג' he who upturns (throws up) ordure into the street.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלָלִים, גְּלָלִין</plural-form>. Sabb. 153
<sup>b</sup> להטיל ג' to cast excrements (of animals). Lev. R. s. 16; Esth. R. to III, 1 מה הג' הללו וכ' as the dung is repulsive.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (with כְּלֵי) 
<italic>a material used for vessels</italic>, supposed to be 
<italic>baked ordure.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. X, 1. Par. V, 5. Mikv. IV, 1; Sabb. 16
<sup>b</sup>. Men. 69
<sup>ab</sup>; a. fr. [Rashi to Sabb. l. c. expl. ג' = שייש, 
<italic>marble</italic>, to Men. l. c. = צפיעי בקר.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00962">
<head-word>גְּלָל, </head-word>
<head-word>גְּלָלָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>untrimmed stone, cobble</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="C00364">גְּוִיל</xref>).</definition>
<notes> [Ezra V, 8.]—Ḥull. 63
<sup>a</sup> אתא ג' a stone fell (from on high); Yalk. Zech. 578 גלאלא. Gitt. 47
<sup>a</sup> Ar. (ed. גַּלְגַּלְתָּא). Ab. Zar. 22
<sup>b</sup>, v. דַּגָּלָא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>lump</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלָלֵי</plural-form>. Ḥull. 112
<sup>a</sup> bot. תרי ג' דמלחא Rashi (ed. ג' מלחא) two lumps of salt.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ordure</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="C00719">גַּלָּא</xref>.</definition>
<notes>—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as supra. B. Kam. 92
<sup>b</sup> (prov.) a dog in his hunger ג' מבלע (Ms. H. sing.) will swallow excrements (Rashi: stones).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>wave</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="C00719">גַּלָּא</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>consequence</italic>
<italic>;</italic> בג' 
<italic>on account of, in order to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XL, 12 (Ms. ג' היכנא). Targ. II Chr. XXIV, 25; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00963">
<head-word>גְּלַלְנִיתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ball-shaped, lump</italic>.</definition>
<notes> מילח' ג' 
<italic>salt in lumps, rock-salt</italic>. Ḥull. 114
<sup>a</sup>; Kidd. 62
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>folding</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="C00950">גְּלִילְתָּא</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00964">
<head-word>גָּלַם</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. גלל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to roll up, to unshape</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Denom. גּוֹלֶם.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of גּוֹלֶם) 
<italic>to calculate in a lump, fix an arbitrary price</italic>, opp. דקדק to calculate exactly.</definition>
<notes> Sifra B’har, Par. 6, ch. IX; B. Kam. 113
<sup>b</sup> יכול יִגְלֹום עליו you might think, he (the redeemer of the Jewish slave in possession of a gentile) was permitted to force an arbitrary price upon him (the gentile); [Rashi: (גלם 
<italic>to double</italic>) he (the gentile owner) might be permitted to ask an exorbitant price].—Part. pass. גָּלוּם, f. גְּלוּמָה 1) 
<italic>wrapt up</italic>. Sot. 42
<sup>a</sup>, v. גַּלְמוּד.—2) 
<italic>roughly shaped, unfinished. </italic>
<plural-form>Pl. גְּלוּמִים, גְּלוּמוֹת</plural-form>. Sifré Num. 158, v. גּוֹלֶם. Ex. R. s. 30 מצות גלומות rough laws (containing no details, assigning no reasons; Var. lect. גולמות, גּוֹלָמִיּוֹת, fr. גּוֹלָמִי).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00969">
<head-word>גַּלְמוּד</head-word>
<head-word>גַּלְמוּדָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="C00964">גלם</xref>; 
<xref rid="D00000">ד</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> format.</definition>
<notes>, v. Fürst H. Dict. s. v.)

<italic>cut off</italic>); v. infra. Tosef. Bekh. IV, 16 איזהו גמום וכ' (ed. Zuck. נמום, corr. acc.) what animal is called 
<italic>gamum?</italic> That which lacks horns, i.e. whose horns are not projecting, v. next w. Ib. 15 הגומים (ed. Zuck. הנימום) read: הַגָּמוּם.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="C01063">
<head-word>גָּמַר, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> cmp. v. 
<xref rid="C01054">גמם</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to polish, touch up, finish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. ג' מלאכתו when he gives to his work the finishing touch; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (in gen.) 
<italic>to complete, end</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. X, 7 גּוֹמֵר עליו את ההלל he reads over it (the fourth cup) the Hallel to the end, v. הַלֵּל.—Tosef. Succ. III, 2 גּוֹמְרִין בהן וכ' on those occasions the 
<italic>entire</italic> Hallel is read; Ber. 14
<sup>a</sup>; Arakh. 10
<sup>a</sup>; Taan. 28
<sup>b</sup>. Ber. 13
<sup>b</sup> חוזר וגוֹמְרָהּ (after the disciples left) did he take it up again and read the whole of the Sh’ma?—Y. Yeb. II, beg. 3
<sup>c</sup> הביאה גוֹמֶרֶת בה coition consummates the levir’s marriage (Bab. ib. 18
<sup>a</sup> קונה קניין גמור), v. מַאֲמַר.—Y. Ber. VI, 10
<sup>d</sup> top ג' מלאכול after he has finished eating; a. fr.—Euphem. 
<italic>to gratify the sexual appetite</italic>. Kerith. II, 4. Pes. 87
<sup>a</sup> (play on 
<italic>Gomer</italic>, Hos. I, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> שהכל גּוֹמְרִים בה all people could gratify their lust on her.</definition>
<notes>—וְגוֹמֵר (abbr. וגו', וג') 
<italic>and one finishes</italic> (the sentence quoted) = 
<italic>and so forth</italic>, &c., a clerical term used in Bible citations to save the writing out of the entire quotation. Ḥull. 98
<sup>a</sup>. Gen. R. s. 51, beg.; a. fr.—*
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. גָּמוּר, f. גְּמוּרָה 
<italic>finished, complete, real, valid</italic>. Kidd. 40
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. צדיק ג' a perfectly righteous man (without faults); רשע ג' a wicked man throughout (without any good quality). Yeb. 18
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. קניין ג' real (legal) possession.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּמוּרִים, גְּמוּרוֹת</plural-form>. Ḥull. 89
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Bets. 2
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. בצים ג' perfectly developed eggs (with shells), v. infra.—3) 
<italic>to destroy</italic>. Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> (play on 
<italic>Gomer</italic>, v. supra) בזזו וגָמְרוּ (Ms. M. גמרו וגמרו) they plundered and destroyed (they destroyed thoroughly).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to conclude, determine, decide.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XVI, 1. Ber. 17
<sup>a</sup> גְּמוֹר בכל לבבך וכ' be determined with all thy heart &c. Shebu. 26
<sup>b</sup> ג' בלבו he resolved (vowed) in his heart, opp. הוציא בשפתיו; Ḥag. 10
<sup>a</sup>.—Erub. 13
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. נמנו וגמרו they were counted (their votes were taken) and they decided.—Snh. III, 7 (42
<sup>a</sup>) גמרו את הדבר when they had closed the case (being ready for publishing the sentence); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to draw a conclusion by analogy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 96
<sup>b</sup> ג' העברה העברה מיוה"כ one forms an analogy between the expressions
<italic>he</italic>
<italic>ĕ</italic>
<italic>bir</italic> &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be fully developed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Par. XI, 7, v. גָּמַל.—בצים גמורות, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>גִּמֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to destroy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> בקשו לגַמֵּר וכ' they intented to destroy the possessions of Israel in her (Gomer’s) days, v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to develop, mature, ripen</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. V, beg. 35
<sup>d</sup> אין פירותיה' מְגַמְּרִין וכ' their fruits ripen only every three years.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִגְמַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be finished, completed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. VI, 1 נ' הדין when proceedings are finished (sentence pronounced). Gen. R. s. 12 נִגְמְרָה מלאכתן they were finished; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="C01064">
<head-word>גְּמַר, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to finish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LVII, 3 דְּיִגְמַר (ed. Lag. די גמר, corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pes. 55
<sup>a</sup> גַּמְרִינָן we dare finish a work commenced. Ib. מִיגְמַר אין אתחולי לא to finish is permitted, but not to begin; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to consume, destroy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job I, 16. Ib. XXII, 20; a. fr. (also 
<italic>Pa.</italic>).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to end, cease</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XII, 2 גְּמִירוּ they are gone. Targ. Prov. V, 11. Ib. XXII, 8; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to conclude, derive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 98
<sup>b</sup> ולִיגְמַר מיניה now let one draw a conclusion from this (by analogy)! Ib. מחידוש לא גַבְרִינָן from an exception we draw no conclusions; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be perfect, ready to answer, to know well</italic>.</definition>
<notes> [Targ. Y. Deut. VI, 7 ותִגְמְרִינוּן וכ', read ותַגְ', v. infra.]—
<italic>Part.</italic> גָּמֵיר. Sabb. 63
<sup>a</sup> והוה גְמִירְנָא וכ' and I knew well the whole Talmud (v. Rabh. D. S. a. l.). Taan. 7
<sup>a</sup> bot. דגְמִירֵי who are learned; ib.
<sup>b</sup> top טפי הוו ג' they would be more learned; a. fr.—Whence: 
<italic>to learn by heart</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to learn traditional law</italic> (cmp. גְּרַס II). Targ. Job XXII, 22 (h. text קח, cmp. לֶקַח).—Sabb. l. c. לִיגְמַר איניש והדר ליסבר one must first learn traditions, and then he may reason; Ab. Zar. 19
<sup>a</sup>, v. גְּרַס II.—Ber. 43
<sup>a</sup> וברכת … גַּמְרִינָן and we are not sufficiently familiar with the laws concerning grace at meals. Yoma 29
<sup>a</sup> מִיגְמַר בעתיקא וכ' to remember well something old (to refresh the memory) is more difficult than to commit to memory a fresh thing. Sabb. l. c. למיגמר מיניה from whom to receive traditions. Sot. 36
<sup>b</sup> לא הוה קגמר he could not remember; a. fr.—Sabb. 96
<sup>b</sup> גמרא גְמִירֵי לה they (the scholars) know it by tradition; ib. 97
<sup>a</sup> הילכתא ג' לה.—גְּמִירֵי they have a tradition, 
<italic>it is a well-known maxim</italic>. Snh. 37
<sup>b</sup> bot. Sot. 34
<sup>a</sup>. Gitt. 47
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>גַּמֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to finish; to consume</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXI, 13 ed. (Ms. גַּמְרִין Part. Pe.). Ib. XIII, 28; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַגְמֵיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to teach verbally</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. VI, 7 [read:] ותַגְמְרִינוּן and thou shalt teach them (v. Ber. 13
<sup>b</sup>).—Sot. 36
<sup>b</sup> אַגְמְרֵיה ולא גמר he taught him (the Hebrew language), but he (Pharaoh) could not remember it. Ḥull. 45
<sup>b</sup> אַגְמְרָךְ גמרא I will teach thee a tradition. B. Kam. 17
<sup>a</sup> לאַגְמוּרֵי as to teaching. Ber. 13
<sup>b</sup>, v. גְּרַס II.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְגְּמַר, אִגְּמַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be finished; to be destroyed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXIII, 17. Targ. Ps. CIX, 23.—Targ. Y. Num. XVIII, 14 דמִגְּמַר (h. text חֵרֶם). Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 19 יִתְגַּמְרוּן (h. text יָחֳרָם).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="C01067">
<head-word>גְּמָרָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="C01063">גְּמַר II</xref>, 5) 
<italic>memorizing of verbal teachings, tradition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 19
<sup>a</sup> bot. הנ"מ סברא אבל ג' מחד רבא וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) this refers to reasoning (dialectics), but as to traditional laws (rules &c.), it is better to study only with one teacher, in order not to be confused by varying wording; Yalk. Ps. 614.—Gitt. 6
<sup>b</sup> הא ג' היא וג' לא שמיע ליה this is merely a tradition (not to be arrived at by way of reasoning) and one may not have heard that tradition (and yet be an able man). B. Mets. 33
<sup>ab</sup> ג' verbal study (opp. to משנה which had been put to writing). Arakḥ. 29
<sup>a</sup> רב גַּמְרֵיה גמיר (not גמור) Rab had his own tradition about it (had it from his teacher that the Mishnah was corrupt). Erub. 60
<sup>a</sup> ג' גמור זמורתא תהא if it is a tradition, learn it by heart, let it be like a song (the wording of which you dare not change); Sabb. 106
<sup>b</sup>; Ab. Zar. 32
<sup>b</sup>; Bets. 24
<sup>a</sup> (variously interpreted in comment.).—Yoma 14
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. משמיה דג' as a tradition (without knowing the reasoning process, cmp. ib. 33
<sup>a</sup> bot.ג' גמירנא 
<pgbrk id="pg256" />וכ'); a. fr.—
<italic>G’mara</italic>, that part of the Talmud containing those discussions, decisions &c. which, after the reduction to writing of the Mishnah, were the materials of verbal studies until they, too, were put to writing.—Abbrev. גמ', a clerical mark in the Talmud Babli editions, to indicate where the Mishnah ends, and the G’mara begins.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C01072">
<head-word>גַּן</head-word>
<head-word>גַּנָּה, </head-word>
<head-word>גִּינָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> גנן)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>a fenced-in place, garden</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—גַּן עֵדֶן 
<italic>paradise, place of future reward</italic>, opp. גֵּיהִינָּם. Pes. 54
<sup>a</sup>; Ned. 39
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 15 beg. גן גדול מעדן the garden was larger than Eden (Eden was a portion of the garden, ref. to Ez. XXXI, 9). Taan. 10
<sup>a</sup> וגן אחד וכ' and the garden was one sixtieth portion of Eden.—Gen. R. l. c. כפיגי שהיא נתונה בגי' like a spring in a garden. Kil. II, 2 זרעוני גנה garden plants. Ex. R. s. 31 גלגל שבגי' the wheel works of the well in the garden; a. fr.—Trnsf. (cmp. hortulus a. κῆπος) 
<italic>woman</italic>. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXI אין גן אלא האשה וכ' 
<italic>gan</italic> (Gen. III, 3) means woman who is compared to a garden (ref. to Cant. IV, 12), מה הגנה זו וכ' as a garden &c. Cant. R. to IV, 12 גַּנָּתִי נעולה והיא מתגניא my consort (Israel) is closed (chaste), and yet defamed.—
<plural-form>Pl. גַּנּוֹת</plural-form>. Lev. R. s. 3, beg. better off is he who owns גינה one garden and &c. ממי שנוטל ג' של וכ' than he who takes other people’s gardens on half-shares; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 85 חורש בגנות (euphem. for sexual intercourse).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<plural-form>Pl. גִּינִּין, גִּינַּיָיא, גַּנַּ'</plural-form>. Targ. II Kings IX, 27.—Lev. R. s. 3, v. אֲגַר II.—ג' דאשקלון
